target.title: fix(channels): clear stale narration drafts when narration stops
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord progress narration could leave a stale narration-only draft visible when narration stopped and the progress draft had no real fallback progress lines to render.

## Why This Change Was Made

The channel progress compositor already treats an empty narration update as the signal to fall back from utility-model narration to normal progress content. This change keeps that boundary complete by deleting the current draft when deletion is available and the fallback would otherwise render empty or label-only, while preserving visible fallback updates for channels without draft deletion and for drafts that still have tool, reasoning, or commentary progress lines.

This PR is AI-assisted.

## User Impact

Users no longer see outdated live status text linger in progress draft mode when narration is disabled mid-turn and there is no remaining progress content to show.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: current-head Discord progress mode deletes a remote narration-only draft when narration clears, then can create a later progress draft in the same flow; label-only fallback without deletion and fallback-to-tool-lines behavior remain covered by focused compositor tests.
- Current-head live Discord proof at `1ad0859913d49e789ba3b6e69b9419660d3ccf30`: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` ran a PR-head script that imported `src/channels/progress-draft-compositor.ts`, `extensions/discord/src/draft-stream.ts`, and `extensions/discord/src/internal/rest.ts`, then drove real Discord REST against a redacted test guild/channel. Local artifact: `.artifacts/proof/pr-103640-discord-draft-narration-clear-pr103640-mrexjcae.json`.
- Live observed result: run `pr103640-mrexjcae` created a narration-only Discord draft (`messageId` suffix `159404`), the empty narration update invoked `deleteCurrent`, a follow-up GET for that message returned Discord `404`, then a later tool-progress update created a new Discord draft (`messageId` suffix `921435`) before cleanup deleted it.
- Focused regression proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/channels/progress-draft-compositor.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 17 tests passing.
- PR diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed after fetching current `upstream/main`.
